agent.name: artifact-grounded finite-state evidence agent

findings.statement: The evaluated atlas run achieved macro-F1 0.646293, weighted-F1 0.977982, and MCC 0.972762.
Single-flow CPU inference had p50 2.116030 ms and p95 3.723656 ms under the recorded timing scope.
At 25% deletion, ranked-feature removal changed predicted-class probability by 0.879771, versus 0.207594 for the random control; the dominant attention branch was protocol (0.402826).

limitations: The agent summarizes measured artifacts and does not establish causality.
It does not replace domain-expert incident assessment.
No language model was used; no LLM capability is claimed.
